question: does replacing D173a's candidate-existence trigger with a true assignment-outcome trigger (the unit's actual selected command this turn, absent the fix, is CHOP on its own fruited cell within shack-distance <=2) achieve >=90% same-turn CHOP fidelity on a 64-task activation sample, and does it then clear the inherited mechanism gate (>=70% reduction of the chop-shadow-shack<=2 harvest_slack sub-class, total harvest_slack not increased, the other five waste detectors not worsened) and value gates (non-regression overall + activated-subset >= +1.0, worst family >= -1.0, catastrophes/negative-mass not worse) on a fresh 2,048-task panel over the same seeds as D173a?
root_cause_being_repaired: D173a's trigger fired on CHOP-candidate *existence* at the unit's cell (chops.iter().any(command == "CHOP {id}")), not on CHOP being the unit's actual assigned/selected action; 41/60 sampled activations were transit units diverted mid-plan (a same-cell CHOP candidate that lost the scoring contest to a better MOVE elsewhere in main_candidates), outside the frozen chop_or_mine_shadows_harvest scope.

panel.seed_range_note: identical seed range to D173a (re-run from scratch per protocol); disjoint from D171a's 9,853,000-9,853,127.

fix_scope.architecture_change_from_d173a: post-selection rewrite of the resident's own final assigned commands (called once from commands(), after MoisanBot::select and after apply_opponent_crop_harvest_contact) rather than a pre-selection candidate injected into main_candidates/endgame_candidates -- necessary because 'is CHOP the unit's actual assignment outcome' cannot be determined from inside a per-unit candidate generator called before MoisanBot::select has seen every unit's candidates
call_sites: commands() -- single call site, immediately before out.extend(selected)
fix_scope.trigger: commands[i] == "CHOP {id}" (the resident's own already-selected command this turn, absent this fix, by construction of running after MoisanBot::select with no prior candidate injection) AND unit is not the scarce farmer AND not an early-opening turn (both exclude the two candidate generators -- scarce_farmer_candidates, early_candidates -- D173a's protocol never touched) AND harvest_power >= 1 AND free_capacity() > 0 AND the plant at the unit's own cell has fruits > 0 AND own-door BFS shack distance <= 2
fix_scope.score: n/a -- this is a command-string rewrite, not a scored candidate
untouched: main_candidates / endgame_candidates internals (both fully reverted to their pre-D173a form)
fix_scope.cross_turn_state: none -- recomputed fresh every call from view/commands plus the two already-computed locals (scarce_farmer_id, early) the caller threads through

control_snapshot: rust/src/d171a_control_resident_snapshot.rs (reused unmodified, shared with D173a; verified same SHA-256 as the dev copy before the fix was applied and again after restore)
verdict_rule: all mechanism gates AND all value gates pass -> QUALIFIED (build candidate pair, STOP at arena gate, new owner authorization required for promotion); any gate fails -> CLOSED (restore dev copy byte-exact, no tuning of distance bound/scoring/condition)
